name: GitHub
description: The repositories your agents check out, branch and open pull requests. Sign in with GitHub to grant repository access so agents can clone, push and open pull requests.

tools.name: github.read_repository
tools.description: Clone the repository and read its files.

tools.name: github.create_branch
tools.description: Push a branch named for the task the agent is working.

tools.name: github.open_pull_request
tools.description: Open a pull request for a person to review.

tools.name: github.merge_pull_request
tools.description: Merge without waiting for a human review.
